scores.tell: Purple rays and gold are saturated like real cards; warm gold hero on cool purple fits. Slight flat purple, little neutral rest.
Whole scene is loud: pink, yellow, blue, green and brown fence all at full chroma. Many hue families with no muted rest. Reads as painterly illustration.
Painted sky, grass and dirt in natural tones. Lower chroma and a realistic palette, not the saturated candy flat colors of the real cards. Close to the grade 2 wagon.
Red booth on a green background is a strong complement like the real towel. Teal-green glass is slightly muddy, and the green is a bit dull.
Fills the whole frame with a turquoise scene and no neutral area. Many hue families, and the ocean is highly detailed rather than flat.
Orange and yellow hero on a purple background with a dark purple accent. Clean complementary roles and a saturated palette like the real cards. No real tell.
Red gloves on blue stripes and orange wood. Chroma is high everywhere, but the red and black give some rest. The wood floor is a bit loud.
Red-orange and yellow on a cyan background. Strong, clean complement in the same candy palette as the real cards. Minor: the cyan is very neon.
Orange-brown boot on pale blue rings. Natural leather color, complementary hue roles and a soft background, like the grade 4 boot. Background is slightly paler than the real cards.
Saturated blue waves with a yellow and orange hero. Good complement, but the background is as loud as the hero and the deep blue is heavy.
